player.noTrackDescription: Choose a playlist to start listening.

library.title: Playlists
library.description: A soundtrack for your next session.
library.emptyDescription: Your Spotify playlists will appear here once connected.
library.emptyTracksDescription: Add some tracks in Spotify to get started.
library.loadFailed: Could not load your music. Try again.
library.longLoading: Reading the playlist. Large playlists may take up to two minutes.
library.trackLimit: Showing the first {{count, number}} tracks to keep memory use bounded. Start the playlist to play beyond this browsing limit.
library.enumerationTimeout: The player did not finish listing the playlist within two minutes.
library.networkFailure: The playlist request could not reach the player or timed out. No HTTP error status was received.
library.invalidResponse: The player returned an invalid or oversized playlist response.
library.httpFailure: The player rejected the playlist request (HTTP {{status}}). Check Temporary logs for details.
library.failureDetails: Open Settings and check Temporary logs for the playlist request status or listing failure.
library.partialMetadata: Some track details have not arrived. Their positions are preserved. Reopening after the cached list expires will try again.
library.refreshing: Updating track details. Your current list remains available.
library.refreshFailed: Could not update this playlist. Showing the last successfully loaded list.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyDescription: Songs you queue in Spotify on your phone will appear here.
queue.readOnly: Manage your queue in Spotify on your phone.
queue.unavailable: Queue updates are unavailable. Showing the last known queue, if available.
queue.pending: The upcoming queue has not been received yet.
queue.rateLimited: Spotify is rate-limiting queue requests (HTTP 429). Requests are paused; the last known queue is kept.
queue.rateLimitedUntil: Spotify is rate-limiting queue requests (HTTP 429). Requests are paused until {{time}}; the last known queue is kept.
queue.httpFailure: Spotify rejected the queue request (HTTP {{status}}). Playback may still work while queue access is unavailable.
queue.differentDevice: Spotify returned a queue that does not match the Deck’s current track. Select Steam Deck on your phone, then refresh.
queue.tokenFailure: The player did not provide a usable token for reading the queue.
queue.inactive: No current track is active on the Deck. Start music on Steam Deck, then refresh.

status.disconnectedDescription: Account setup arrives with the playback backend. This prototype needs no sign-in.
status.offlineDescription: Showing your last known playback and queue.

errors.actionFailed: That action didn’t go through. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Playback controls are unavailable right now.
errors.notFound: That playlist or track is no longer available.
errors.disposed: The player has closed. Reopen the plugin to continue.

hints.keyboard: Arrow keys to navigate · Enter to select · Esc to go back

preview.title: Your music. Still in the game.
preview.description: A compact player for Steam Deck’s Quick Access menu.
preview.noAudio: Prototype only. No Spotify connection or audio.
preview.note: Phone actions update the same mock session. They are preview tools, not plugin controls.
preview.installNote: Installation and phone sign-in are simulated. The QR code is a demonstration; no files are downloaded.

backend.label: librespot
backend.chooseOnPhone: Choose a playlist here or play music on Steam Deck from Spotify on your phone.
backend.disconnected: Install the player in Setup, then sign in on your phone.
backend.libraryDescription: Choose music in Spotify on your phone and try again later.

installer.title: Install Spotify player
installer.description: Install the lightweight Spotify Connect player on your Deck.
installer.readyDescription: The player is installed. Sign in using your phone to start listening.
installer.unsupported: Player installation is available on Steam Deck and other Linux x86_64 devices.
installer.downloadFailed: Could not download or install the player. Check your connection and available storage, then try again.
installer.tlsFailed: Could not verify the download server’s certificate. Check the Deck’s date and time and update Decky Loader, then retry.
installer.permissionDenied: The player’s installation folder is not writable. Check its permissions, then retry.
installer.storageFull: There is not enough storage to install the player. Free some space, then retry.
installer.downloadTimeout: The player download timed out. Check your connection, then retry.
installer.dependencyMissing: A required Python library is unavailable. Update Decky Loader, then retry.
installer.httpFailed: The download server returned HTTP {{status}}. Try again later.
installer.invalidArchive: The download could not be verified. Try again.
installer.sourceDescription: Downloaded from the go-librespot project. Spotify Premium is required.
installer.restart: Login credentials are kept when you repair the player.
installer.invalidArchiveExisting: The download could not be verified. Your previous installation has been kept. Try again.

cache.title: Music cache
cache.description: Reuse encrypted audio files from tracks you play. Enabled by default with a 1 GB disk limit; older files are evicted. Spotify access is still required. This does not provide offline downloads.
cache.retained: Turning this off keeps existing cached files and stops using the cache after the player restarts.
cache.pending: Saved. Restart the player to apply this change. Restarting interrupts playback; you may need to resume music from your phone.

diagnostics.title: Temporary sign-in log
diagnostics.description: Latest player and playlist events. Credentials and raw player logs are hidden.
diagnostics.empty: Start sign-in to record diagnostic events.
diagnostics.codePending: Pairing endpoint responded; no code yet.
diagnostics.invalidCode: Pairing response failed URL, code or expiry validation.
diagnostics.apiTimeout: Local player API request timed out.
diagnostics.apiUnavailable: Local player API is unavailable or returned an invalid response.
diagnostics.startupTimeout: No sign-in code or session after 90 seconds; stopping player.
diagnostics.bridgeFailed: The backend monitor failed to start or stopped unexpectedly.
diagnostics.nativeLockFailed: Player reported another instance using this configuration.
diagnostics.nativeDependencyFailed: Player reported a missing or incompatible system library.
diagnostics.nativeDnsFailed: Player could not resolve a network host.
diagnostics.nativeDeviceCodeFailed: Player could not request a Spotify device code.
diagnostics.nativeClientTokenFailed: Player could not obtain a Spotify client token.
diagnostics.nativeNetworkFailed: Player could not reach Spotify’s network endpoints.
diagnostics.nativeDiscoveryFailed: Player could not initialize local discovery.
diagnostics.nativeAuthenticationFailed: Player could not exchange the approved device code.
diagnostics.nativeAudioFailed: Player reported an audio initialization error.
diagnostics.nativeError: Player reported an unclassified error; raw details are hidden.
diagnostics.playlistRequestFailed: Playlist listing request failed (HTTP status {{value}}; -1 means no status was received).
diagnostics.playlistEnumerationTimeout: The player did not enumerate this playlist within the loading deadline.
diagnostics.playlistMetadataPending: The playlist opened with {{value}} unresolved track details.
diagnostics.nativePlaylistFailed: Spotify playlist resolution or enumeration failed (HTTP status {{value}}; -1 means no status was reported).
diagnostics.nativePlaylistTimeout: Spotify playlist resolution or enumeration timed out.
diagnostics.playlistEnumerating: Reading playlist entries (up to two minutes, browsing capped at 500 tracks).
diagnostics.playlistListingReady: Playlist enumeration finished with {{value}} browsable entries.
diagnostics.playlistRetrying: Retrying a temporary playlist request failure (retry {{value}} of 2).
diagnostics.playlistCacheHit: Reopened {{value}} tracks from the short-lived playlist disk cache.

auth.instructions: Scan with your phone camera and approve access on Spotify’s website.
auth.qrLabel: QR code for Spotify phone sign-in
auth.codeAlternative: Or visit spotify.com/pair on your phone and enter this code.
auth.expiredDescription: Get a new code to finish signing in on your phone.
auth.failedDescription: Check your connection and try again. Spotify Premium is required.
auth.startupFailedDescription: The player stopped before it could request a sign-in code. Try starting it again. If this continues, repair the player in Setup.
auth.connected: Signed in. Choose music here or select Steam Deck in Spotify on your phone.
